golden_source: gen_fixtures.py:_rasterize_reference (an original pure-torch f64 implementation — gsplat _rasterize_to_pixels depends on CUDA/nerfacc and cannot be used on macOS, 07). The formulas and constants = gsplat@77ab983 RasterizeToPixels3DGSDevice.cuh:44-55 + SerialBatchFwd.cu:179-296 + Common.h:97-114 (spec 05).
note: Render equation: sigma=0.5(A dx²+C dy²)+B dx dy (delta=mean-pixel_center, center=+0.5), alpha=min(0.99, opac·exp(-sigma)), valid=!(sigma<0 || alpha<1/255), early termination at next_T=T(1-alpha)<=1e-4 **exclusive** (the triggering Gaussian is not included, Fwd.cu:246-251). last_ids = the **absolute isect index** (relative to flatten_ids) of the last contributing Gaussian, or 0 when nothing contributed (a dual-purpose encoding — because MAX_ALPHA=0.99 the first Gaussian can never cross the threshold, so there is no contamination, Fwd.cu:186/261/293). The background is applied globally in one pass outside the tile loop: render_colors += (1-render_alphas)·bg (07 Correction 4 — bg is written to the in-bounds pixels of empty tiles as well). masks=None is fixed (07 Correction 6). flatten_ids is the **sorted golden** (the isect sort contract, 03), and isect_offsets is the global [I,TH,TW] cumulative sum. Comparison: render_colors/render_alphas with tolerances, last_ids **exact** (the flake policy at the threshold boundary is 07 open question #5 — to be decided after measurement). The Metal bwd test feeds this fixture's fwd goldens (render_alphas/last_ids) in as input to block fwd error propagation (07). bwd: inject v_render_colors/v_render_alphas → v_means2d/v_conics/v_colors/v_opacities (last_ids is not differentiated). A Gaussian with the MAX_ALPHA clamp active contributes 0 to v_conics/v_means2d/v_opacities and only v_colors survives (the clamp_max autograd ≡ the Bwd.cu:259 gate). Self-verification: (a) T decays monotonically and the surviving T>1e-4, (b) the render_alphas==1-T_final identity (f64 1e-12), (c) an all-pixel comparison against a serial per-pixel scalar oracle (a literal translation of the CUDA fwd), (d) the raster_small hand-check assertions. The total fixtures size cap was relaxed to < 2MB by approval (the 1c Task 2 brief) — the raster image tensors [I,H,W,{3,1}] (render/v_render) dominate the size. A single tile (tile_n_bits=0) — dedicated to 3 batch-loop iterations, the early-exit vote, and bwd atomic contention. The always_invalid_ids=[0,32) range has opac<1/255 and is therefore invalid at every pixel (all expected gradients are 0 — asserted by the generator). non_psd_conic_id=40 is a hyperbolic conic with det<0 — at some pixels it is skipped by sigma<0 alone even though alpha≥1/255 (the generator asserts that the gate fires, and asserts that pixels with sigma>=0 contribute by colors grad != 0).
